summary: Sky Quarry Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 7.01 Regulation FD Disclosure announcing that in March 2026, the company entered into an exclusivity agreement to evaluate a potential transaction involving the acquisition of digital infrastructure assets. Discussions are ongoing but no definitive terms have been agreed upon. The company received information about the counterparty's plans including discussions with a potential tenant regarding a long-term lease and consideration of several financing options. No assurance that the transaction will be completed.
